parameters.query:
SELECT
  c.access_token,
  c.status,
  c.bridge_enabled,
  c.ml_user_id,
  a.custom_attributes->'config'->'prompts' as prompts,
  a.custom_attributes->'config'->'response_delay' as delay,
  a.id as chatwoot_account_id,
  a.custom_attributes->'config'->'post_venta_ia' as pv_ia,
  a.custom_attributes->>'receive_only' as receive_only,
  (SELECT id FROM inboxes
   WHERE account_id = a.id
   AND name ILIKE '%Post-venta (MercadoLibre)%'
   LIMIT 1) as meli_inbox_id,
  (SELECT id FROM teams
   WHERE account_id = a.id
   AND name ILIKE '%Post-Venta%'
   LIMIT 1) as meli_team_id,
  (SELECT display_id FROM conversations
   WHERE account_id = a.id
   AND additional_attributes->>'pack_id' = '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').item.json.body.pack_id }}'
   ORDER BY id DESC
   LIMIT 1) as existing_pv_conversation_id
FROM meli_credentials c
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = c.account_id
WHERE c.ml_user_id = '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').item.json.body.user_id }}';

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO meli_questions (question_id, account_id, status)
SELECT
  'ms_' || '{{ $input.first().json.body._id }}',
  (SELECT account_id FROM meli_credentials WHERE ml_user_id = '{{ $input.first().json.body.user_id }}'),
  'processing'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM meli_questions WHERE question_id = 'ms_' || '{{ $input.first().json.body._id }}'
)
RETURNING question_id;

SELECT id AS order_db_id, estado_conversacion, handoff_reason, last_sentiment,
       consecutive_enojado, repeat_count, ultimos_mensajes_comprador, blocked_substatus, last_message_at
FROM meli_orders
WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM meli_credentials WHERE ml_user_id = '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').item.json.body.user_id }}')
  AND pack_id = '{{ $json.pack_id }}'
LIMIT 1;

parameters.query:
UPDATE meli_orders
SET last_sentiment = '{{ $json.sentiment }}',
    consecutive_enojado = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.sentiment }}' = 'ENOJADO' THEN consecutive_enojado + 1 ELSE 0 END,
    last_message_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $('check_lifecycle').item.json.order_db_id }}';

UPDATE meli_orders
SET repeat_count = '{{ $json.repeat_count }}',
    ultimos_mensajes_comprador = '{{ $json.ultimos_nuevos }}'::jsonb,
    last_message_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $('check_lifecycle').item.json.order_db_id }}';
